title: Concept: Transitive group excluded per dependency
description: build.gradle declares an exclusion that removes a group from the graph, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an exclusion that removes a group from the graph.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an exclusion that removes a group from the graph.
